description.p: OxyBrush is an open-source digital sculpting application written in Rust. The model fills the screen, tools appear when you need them, and brushes respond immediately on dense meshes.

ul.li: 16 brushes including Clay, Clay Strips, Crease, Layer, Polish and Topological Move
Alphas, stroke stabilizer, line and stamp strokes
Box and lasso masking and selection
Multiple pieces per document, voxel remesh, merge and decimation
Project files with autosave and crash recovery; OBJ and STL import/export

description.p: This is an early alpha release: expect rough edges.

screenshot.caption: Sculpting with two pieces and a face group

description.p: Cut new edges with the Poly Edit Knife and round outlines with To Circle. Mask or show with circle, ellipse and curve selections. Give each brush its own pressure curves, keep imported alphas in a shared library, choose the axis for mirror duplicates, and optionally show inactive pieces lighter to save memory.

Make linked and mirrored copies of a piece that follow it as you sculpt. Each brush keeps its own settings and alpha, with separate pen pressure curves for strength and size. Boolean seams come out smooth. Poly Edit picks whole loops and bridges holes. Fixes long-lens zoom, far-side wireframe edges and painted detail across subdivision levels.

Mix theme colors, controls and shadows. Use the unified title bar on Windows and Linux and the native menu bar on macOS. Organize the Recipe Box and place surface instances by mask or spacing. Subdivision preserves UVs and imported polygons. The Blender bridge keeps models upright and reuses the running window.

Move placed recipes on the surface, edit linked mirrored pairs, and save recipe changes back to the Recipe Box. New tabs inherit the current material by default. Grab-family brushes make rounded pulls near the mirror plane, and Pieces list controls work again.

Fix tab close button hit-testing, ensure new-tab actions always open a fresh tab, let File > New open alongside modified tabs, pin tab overflow and new-tab controls, and replace the fixed bottom Parts Bin strip with a collapsible pull-out drawer anchored to the brush shelf edge.

Complete multi-tab project support with tab bar, keyboard shortcuts, startup session restore, multi-tab crash recovery, cross-tab Copy/Paste piece with living strokes, plugin/agent/bridge tab isolation, and a shared 4 GiB LRU undo budget. Fix grab-family symmetry blending near the mirror plane, add the Parts Bin library for reusable details and curve path editing for Living Strokes, add outliner Shift-range selection and batch parenting, and consolidate theme controls into Preferences > Appearance.

Fix inspector panel runaway width expansion in Standard and Touch friendly layout presets by enforcing panel max_size bounds. Replace missing font characters for Expand All, Collapse All, and fold chevrons with crisp vector icons. Fix piece row context menus and add a direct Parent to menu. Enhance drag-and-drop parenting, unparenting, and sibling reordering across scene hierarchies.

Import Autodesk FBX files spanning modern 7.x binary, ASCII, and legacy 5.8/6.x formats. Experience the Sculptor theme with dark charcoal slate panels, pill tracks with concentric clay sliders, and sculpted silver-clay icons. Organize scenes with the upgraded outliner featuring folders, interactive parenting, and real-time search. Customize UI color hue, tint intensity, and brightness.

Hierarchical tree-view scene outliner for pieces with folding, drag-and-drop parenting, and transform propagation. Import 4K alphas with native 16-bit depth and aspect-ratio preservation. Resize the inspector panel narrower with wrapping controls. Preserve mesh volume across voxel remeshes with level-set zero crossing projection. Fix Deform window title bar dragging and update project branding.

Sculpt dense meshes up to 200M+ triangles with partitioned GPU rendering, bounded draw calls, and compressed undo history. Multires details and hidden pieces use less memory. Reorder pieces by drag-and-drop, join picked pieces, isolate a piece with Alt-click, align Poly Edit gizmo axes, invert brush alphas, and pick export file types.

Blur or sharpen the mask with Ctrl+click, hide the masked faces, mask everything outside a box or lasso by pressing Alt before letting go, and sort the brush list A–Z. In an empty scene the brush size slider and the floor grid now work.

Start from an empty scene, import several files together, extrude Poly Edit faces along the gizmo, group the masked area, and choose an export type from the File menu. Window resizing is smoother, brush defaults are updated, and fixes improve Crease symmetry, Kelvin Grab, Poly Edit picks and grouping visible islands.

Living strokes remember what was drawn, including curves, stamps, lines and a captured alpha, and Edit… sculpts a stroke again with a new brush, Raise or Carve, size, strength, falloff, alpha or spacing. Later strokes stay as they were. The hard-edge angle in View > Shading sets how sharp a corner must be before those faces shade flat (40° by default; 180° is Off).

One transform gizmo moves, turns and scales at once, and works in Poly Edit too, where Shift+drag extrudes what's picked. Poly Edit has soft selection. Several pieces can move together, Merge down joins a piece with the one below it, and tube profiles can mix sharp and smooth corners.

Area lights with soft shadows, and an option to keep the matcap under the lights. Tubes can have any cross-section and sharp corners. Poly Edit has Faces, Edges and Points modes. Low-poly models shade with crisp, flat faces. Any brush can have its own hotkey, and Shift+Tab hides just the settings panel.

The transform gizmo follows Mirror X, Y and Z. Gravity is much stronger. Stamp strokes are as strong as freehand ones and show while you drag. Kelvin Grab no longer creases long pulls. Poly Edit can pick several faces and cut centred or paired edge loops.

Copy one piece onto the faces of another as live copies that follow the surface (surface instances), paint face groups with a brush, add edge loops at the edge of the mask for crisp hard edges, and give each brush its own Gravity. Lengths can be shown in millimetres or inches, and File > Revert reloads the last save. Poly Edit no longer shows edges through the model.

Orbiting turns around the point of the model under the cursor (or the last stroke). Tubes can be twisted, coiled like a spring or braided from three strands. glTF and GLB files can be imported, and exported compressed; UVs are kept from import to export. New Sharp Crease brush and sculpt layers made ahead of time. The brush cursor follows a hovering pen on Windows.

Each piece can have its own material (matcap). Living strokes can be copied to the mirrored side, split into one stroke per side, and exported to glTF with each group as a shape key; plugins and agents can read and edit them. The voxel remesh keeps the toes of posed or rigged models whole and handles meshes with flipped normals.

Subdivision levels now make quads (Catmull-Clark) that keep the edge loops of a quad model, with Poly Edit creases kept sharp, and a Smooth toggle to add resolution without rounding the shape. Subdivide masked adds resolution only where you mask. Living strokes can be grouped into layers and are saved with the project. A Disc primitive, and a voxel remesh that keeps close fingers and toes apart.

Living strokes: an option to keep strokes editable, so any stroke can be faded, deleted or seen on its own later. Poly Edit gains bevels with rounded rows, bridge, edge slide, spin, split face, creases and a live smooth subdivision preview. Human base meshes and quad spheres to start from. The voxel remesh fills models with holes and overlapping parts solid, with an optional Shell.

Poly Edit, a new tool for modeling low-polygon pieces by their faces, edges and points: extrude, inset, insert edge loops, close holes and weld points. A brush size on the model that follows the zoom. Vertex colors imported from OBJ and PLY files, and PLY import. The transform gizmo shows live totals and the actual size and position, and takes exact values. Ctrl+plus and Ctrl+minus zoom the view.
Undo on the active piece only (Ctrl+Alt+Z, or the default for Ctrl+Z in Preferences). Reopen the last stroke as an editable curve, or use its path as a Curve Move curve or a tube path.

A Deform window with 25 whole-piece deformers (bend, twist, taper, inflate, polish and more) that respect the mask. Mask border and Mask group borders. A new interface font, Inter, with softer text in the dark themes, and larger Mirror X, Y and Z buttons.

Mesh, Symmetrize mirrors one half of a piece onto the other and welds the seam. Split masked moves the masked part of a piece into a new piece, and Join combines pieces without remeshing (Merge is now Merge + remesh). Five new bundled plugins. The retopology tool's Tab+drag now pulls out a new quad. Buttons and brush icons can have colors of their own.

One Theme window holds themes, colors, interface size, corners and a new slider thickness option. With a pen, dragging a panel scrolls it, holding the pen still opens menus and tooltips, and a new navigation preset uses the pen's side buttons.

Points in the retopology tool can be pinned so relaxing leaves them in place. Dragging the axis gizmo orbits the view. Opening a file closes the Home window, and on macOS project files show the OxyBrush icon.

Alphas captured from view can be up to 4096 pixels with smooth edges, are saved with the project, and can be exported as 16-bit PNG images to edit in other apps. A new cube from the File menu no longer has open seams.

File > Close project returns to the start screen. OBJ files whose materials failed to parse now import. Imported meshes in other units (such as millimetres) are scaled to fit the scene, and box masking follows symmetry. Window title bars are much slimmer. The Studio theme is refined: slider handles are solid bars, corners are a little squarer, and windows and menus cast a smaller, fainter shadow.

Pen pressure now works on Linux tablets, the window opens where it was left, files open by dropping them on the window, and meshes use about 18% less memory. A new Studio theme has bar sliders and quieter headings, and brush names can be hidden in the shelf. In-app plugins can change face groups and topology, preview their result before it is applied, offer richer settings and be stopped.

Dynamic detail now makes even triangles that stay under the brush. Saving to network drives works around what they refuse and explains a failed save; the interface scale slider no longer runs away. The retopology tool can subdivide its mesh and project the sculpt's detail onto it. Vertex color is exported in glTF, PLY and OBJ. Tubes can be edited again after Accept, an open Curve Move curve is saved with the project, and brush settings can be remembered between sessions.

A retopology tool rebuilds a sculpt as a clean quad mesh you draw on its surface, with X mirroring. Voxel remesh is up to 17 times faster and shows how many triangles it will make; decimate is about five times faster. Vertex color, mask and face groups now survive remesh, merge, booleans and decimate. The rotate gizmo uses rings.

The transform gizmo gains plane handles, snapping with Shift, typed values, pivot and axis choices, mirror, put on the ground and centre at origin. A Plugins menu puts every plugin one click away, and OxyBrush now comes with in-app plugins: Displace, Mask by Height, Color Ramp, Array and Measure.

Primitives are parametric and low-poly by default, with voxel remesh as an option. A Tube brush adds tubes into the piece being sculpted. Plugins can be installed from a single .oxyaddon file, for in-app or Python plugins, and in-app plugins can now set the mask and colors and add pieces. F frames the active piece, and the zoom direction can be inverted.

A Blender bridge sends meshes from Blender to OxyBrush and back, keeping the same Blender objects when their vertices are unchanged. Plugins can run inside OxyBrush in a sandbox, with their own panels. Close holes fills openings in a piece, and an alpha can be captured from the view.

A Tube tool draws a smooth tube along a path you can reshape, for horns, tentacles, tails and cables. The viewport can be lit with up to four lights with soft shadows. Focal shift makes brushes firmer or softer, and S, U, I and O open a slider under the pointer. Cylinder, cone and torus pieces, Split hidden, and a floor grid button were added. Grab no longer leaves jagged seams, and the Windows icon, the log folder, Tab and the brush shelf were fixed.

Dynamic detail adds triangles where you sculpt, so you can build a shape from a plain sphere. The new Curve Move brush bends and stretches a part along a curve you draw. Strokes can be drawn as editable curves. Each piece now mirrors about its own centre, which fixes symmetry on models away from the origin. Tablet pressure works on macOS and in the Flatpak, with a two-point pressure curve. Plugins can read the scene, camera and geometry as data.

Mask extract shows a live preview you can adjust before accepting it. A floor grid under the model follows its size and position. New Pen & tablet settings shape the pressure curve, and on macOS quitting now asks to save unsaved changes.

New Midnight theme: deep navy panels with thin blue outlines and soft shadows, plus a Pill corner style for fully rounded buttons and fields. The Midnight quick preset applies both with the emerald accent and a navy viewport. Documentation brought up to date.

Fixes: the Insert Primitives brush shows the shape growing as you drag, the cut tools show their line and follow symmetry, a moved gizmo pivot stays put, and the Windows Ink pen side button navigates instead of sculpting. Options that used other products' names are renamed, the Matte theme is readable again, and long menus fit on screen.

Mask extract sculpting feature with thickness extrusion and boundary smoothing, C1 smooth symmetry blending for Grab brush, customizable theme presets and accent colors, and high-poly gizmo performance fixes.

Pixar Regularized Kelvinlet sculpting brushes (Kelvin Grab, Kelvin Twist, Kelvin Scale) with elastodynamic volume preservation, and hardware-accelerated real-time wireframe overlay with Shift+W shortcut and opacity controls.
Embedded Python SDK auto-provisioning into user data directory, auto-provisioned bundled example plugins in plugins folder, and standalone script candidate loader.
Python plugin error diagnostic improvements, expanded oxybrush SDK with MeshStats dataclass, bundled mesh stats reporter plugin, and comprehensive GitHub Wiki documentation.

Python plugin and scripting system with pure Python SDK, local AI agent (MCP) integration, keymap editor and navigation presets (MMB orbit), high-res mesh performance optimizations, autosave control, focal length, surface-aligned cursor and custom viewport backgrounds.

Vertex color painting, a transform gizmo for posing, brush presets, glTF/GLB and PLY export with LOD chains and a command-line tool, a command palette and built-in guide, flat shading, custom matcaps and a quick menu at the cursor.
Ambient occlusion and cavity shading in the viewport, faster work with dense meshes (subdivision level changes run in the background), and roughly twice as fast decimation.

Subdivision levels (multiresolution), a friendlier interface with brush, alpha and material previews, Standard, Compact and Touch layouts, arrangeable panels and brush order, and settings that are remembered between sessions.
New brushes (Polish, Planar Trim, Topological Move, Noise), alphas, stroke stabilizer and stroke modes, box/lasso masking and selection, and tester tools (log file, bug-report links).
First public alpha: sculpting core, multiple pieces, voxel remesh, decimation, face groups, project files with autosave, Windows and Linux builds.
